sample.description: Aggregate 4-lag VAR in log CPI (FRED CPIAUCSL quarterly mean) and log real GDP (FRED GDPC1) 1997Q1-2019Q4, n_raw=92 quarters (88 usable after 4 lags, T_est=88); forecast 2020Q1-2024Q1 (17 quarters) year-ended inflation FE; filtering: QE mean of CPIAUCSL, log, drop NA, OLS, tilde Omega for year-ended p_t - p_t-4 per Appendix C

not_rebuilt.count_PCE_categories: BEA National Accounts Underlying Detail Tables for 136 PCE categories (1988M1-2023M9) require BEA API tables not available via public FRED; public FRED has only aggregate PCEPI/DPCERA
not_rebuilt.tally_explosive_VARs: Requires estimating 12-lag VAR for each of 136 BEA PCE categories; without BEA per-category data the tally of 2 explosive VARs cannot be verified
not_rebuilt.est_euro_FE_2022Q4: Euro area quarterly HICP level (and euro GDP) vintage 1997Q1-2019Q4 not available via public FRED at quarterly log-price level; FRED gives only OECD yoy rates CPALTT01OM659N
not_rebuilt.est_rho_lubricants_abs_upper: Category-specific rho for 'lubricants and fluids' requires BEA UD Tables per-category data
not_rebuilt.est_rho_food_farms: Category rho for 'food produced and consumed on farms' requires BEA UD Tables
not_rebuilt.est_food_supply_low_2022M03: Category historical decomposition for PCE category requires BEA UD Tables VAR
not_rebuilt.est_joint_uniform_prob: Joint posterior probability under uniform prior requires full Bayesian MCMC over phi posterior (Minnesota+soc prior hyperparameters) with 10k theta draws per phi (100k total) - not computable from OLS point estimate
not_rebuilt.est_joint_lower_prob: Same posterior simulation limitation (Giacomini-Kitagawa 2021 robust Bayes, 10k theta draws per phi)

sample.substitutions: Public FRED vintages 2026-10-30 (CPIAUCSL SA, GDPC1 chained 2017$) vs GP24 private vintage; quarterly CPI as QE mean of monthly CPIAUCSL levels then log vs paper unspecified quarterly aggregation; OLS point estimate vs Bayesian Minnesota+soc prior (10k phi draws, 10 theta per phi) - SE for rho via sqrt((1-rho^2)^2/(n-1)), FE SE=0 (fixed horizon); monthly PCE aggregate VAR12 via FRED PCEPI/DPCERA 1988M1-2023M9 (n=429) illustration only for method; identified set bounds via analytic eigenvector method at OLS estimate (paper Fig2 posterior means of bounds with 68% robust credible intervals)

notes: Choices paper leaves open: quarterly CPI aggregation (quarterly mean of CPI level then log, standard); calendar via PeriodIndex Q-DEC QE resample; no risk-free rate. Method exactly per paper: SVAR y=(p,q), Sigma_tr Cholesky, Q(theta) rotation, IS_theta=[arctan(sigma22/sigma21),0] if rho<0 else [-pi/2, arctan(-sigma21/sigma22)], Omega_h=sum c1l Sigma_tr^{-1} u', tilde Omega_h=Omega_h - Omega_{h-4} for h>=4, bounds via endpoints + eigenvectors of S=(Omega+Omega')/2 sign norm cos>=0. Deviations: OLS VAR(4) vs Bayesian Minnesota+soc prior - rho OLS 0.22 vs paper posterior mean 0.23 (both low) but FE 6.13pp vs 7.7pp due to vintage/revision and prior shrinkage; supply IS OLS [0.39,5.35] vs paper [0.2,7.3] both wide ~6-87% of FE, confirming largely uninformative. All headline numbers computed from data fetched inside script via FRED CSV.
